name: eyesonit-typescript-sdk
description: EyesOnIt is an advanced, real-time Large Vision Model for processing images and video. The typescript SDK for EyesOnIt simplifies the use of EyesOnIt from node.js and react applications.

scripts.docs:api:clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('generated/docs/sdk-api',{ recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.docs:api: npm run docs:api:clean && npm run docs:api:generate
